```{r}
# --- Configuration ---
MODEL_NAME <- "model_B1cond" # Switch to "model_q1cond" as needed
# MODEL_NAME <- "model_q1cond" 

fitDirBase <- "data/pathfinder_1cond/"

# --- Data Loading Helper ---
load_fits <- function(model_name, base_dir) {
  fitDir <- file.path(base_dir, model_name)
  cellLines <- list.files(fitDir)
  # Filter out non-directories or files if necessary, assuming structure holds
  cellLines <- cellLines[dir.exists(file.path(fitDir, cellLines))]
  
  if(length(cellLines) == 0) stop("No cell line folders found in ", fitDir)
  
  ploidy <- c("hi","lo")
  conds <- expand.grid(cellLine=cellLines, ploidy=ploidy, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  x <- lapply(1:nrow(conds), function(i){
    cellLine <- conds$cellLine[i]
    ploidy <- conds$ploidy[i]
    
    target_file <- file.path(fitDir, cellLine, ploidy, paste0("optim_", model_name, ".Rds"))
    target_data <- file.path(fitDir, cellLine, ploidy, "stan_data.Rds")
    
    if (!file.exists(target_file) || !file.exists(target_data)) return(NULL)
    
    opt <- readRDS(target_file)
    data <- readRDS(target_data)
    
    # Check structure of opt
    if(length(opt) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    ok <- sapply(opt, '[[', "retcode", simplify=TRUE) == 0
    if (sum(ok) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    lp <- sapply(opt[ok], '[[', "lp", simplify=TRUE)
    pars <- do.call(rbind, lapply(opt[ok], '[[', "pars"))
    
    list(mean_ok = mean(ok), lp=lp, pars=pars, cellLine=cellLine, ploidy=ploidy, data=data)
  })
  
  # Filter nulls
  x <- x[!sapply(x, is.null)]
  # Filter those with 0 successes (though handled above)
  mean_OK <- sapply(x, '[[', "mean_ok")
  x <- x[mean_OK > 0]
  return(x)
}

x <- load_fits(MODEL_NAME, fitDirBase)

# --- LP Processing and Plotting ---
proc_lp <- function(xi){
  lp <- xi$lp
  lp <- lp[order(lp, decreasing = FALSE)]
  data.frame(rank=1:length(lp), lp=lp, lp_diff=pmin(100, max(lp)-lp), cellLine=xi$cellLine, ploidy=xi$ploidy)
}

if (length(x) > 0) {
  df_lp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(x, proc_lp))
  
  library(ggplot2)
  p1 <- ggplot(df_lp, aes(x=rank, y=lp_diff, color=ploidy)) +
    facet_wrap(ploidy~cellLine, scales="free", ncol=5) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(title = paste(MODEL_NAME, "- LP Diff"))
  print(p1)
  
  p2 <- ggplot(df_lp, aes(x=rank, y=lp, color=ploidy)) +
    facet_wrap(ploidy~cellLine, scales="free", ncol=5) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(title = paste(MODEL_NAME, "- Absolute LP"))
  print(p2)
  
  bests <- aggregate(list(lp=df_lp$lp), by=list(cellLine=df_lp$cellLine, ploidy=df_lp$ploidy), max)
  print(bests)
  print(paste("Total Best LP:", sum(bests$lp)))
} else {
  message("No valid fits found for ", MODEL_NAME)
}
```



```{r}

plot_ppc_from_draws <- function(y_sim_draws_mat, stan_data, pars, cell_line, ploidy, model_name, cond_label = "Condition") {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(tibble); library(patchwork) })
  
  # 1. Parse Sims
  idx_df <- tibble(variable = colnames(y_sim_draws_mat)) %>%
    mutate(clean = gsub("^y_sim\\[|\\]$", "", variable)) %>%
    separate(clean, c("w","g","s"), sep = ",", convert = TRUE)
  
  sims_df <- as_tibble(y_sim_draws_mat) %>%
    mutate(draw = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-draw, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
    left_join(idx_df, by = "variable") %>%
    mutate(
      well_idx = as.integer(w),
      time = as.numeric(stan_data$t_grid[g]),
      # Map s index to state name. 
      # Model B: 1=NL, 2=ND, 3=G
      # Model Q: 1=NL, 2=ND, 3=G, 4=qN. 
      type = case_when(s == 1 ~ "NL", s == 2 ~ "ND", s == 3 ~ "G", s == 4 ~ "qN", TRUE ~ as.character(s))
    ) %>%
    select(draw, well_idx, time, type, value) %>%
    filter(!is.na(type))
  
  # 2. Parse Obs
  meta <- tibble(well_idx = seq_len(stan_data$N_wells), G0 = as.numeric(stan_data$G0_per_well), exp_id = as.integer(stan_data$exp_id)) %>%
    mutate(Condition = cond_label, G0_lbl = factor(paste0(G0, " mM"), levels = paste0(sort(unique(G0)), " mM")))
  
  obs_counts <- tibble(
    well_idx = as.integer(stan_data$well_idx_count),
    time = as.numeric(stan_data$t_grid[stan_data$grid_idx_count]),
    NL = as.numeric(stan_data$N_obs),
    ND = as.numeric(stan_data$D_obs)
  ) %>% pivot_longer(c(NL, ND), names_to = "type", values_to = "value") %>% left_join(meta, by = "well_idx")
  
  obs_gluc <- tibble(
    well_idx = as.integer(stan_data$well_idx_gluc),
    time = as.numeric(stan_data$t_grid[stan_data$grid_idx_gluc]),
    lum = as.numeric(stan_data$lum_obs),
    dil = as.numeric(stan_data$dilution)
  ) %>%
    left_join(meta %>% select(well_idx, exp_id, Condition, G0_lbl), by = "well_idx") %>%
    mutate(value = pmax(0, (lum - as.numeric(stan_data$calib_b_fixed[exp_id])) / (as.numeric(stan_data$calib_a_fixed[exp_id]) * dil)), type = "G") %>%
    select(well_idx, time, type, value, exp_id, Condition, G0_lbl)
  
  obs_df <- bind_rows(obs_counts, obs_gluc)
  sims_df <- sims_df %>% left_join(meta %>% select(well_idx, Condition, G0_lbl, exp_id), by = "well_idx")
  
  # 3. Handle Reference Lines (Model Specific)
  hline_df <- NULL
  
  if (model_name == "model_B1cond" || model_name == "model_B1") {
    # Existing logic for B
    g50a <- exp(as.numeric(pars[1, "logp[5]"]))
    g50d <- g50a * exp(as.numeric(pars[1, "logp[7]"])) 
    g50g <- g50a * exp(as.numeric(pars[1, "logp[11]"]))
    
    hline_base <- tidyr::expand_grid(
      Condition = unique(meta$Condition),
      G0_lbl    = levels(meta$G0_lbl)
    )
    
    # Construct DF for plotting
    hline_df <- bind_rows(
      hline_base %>% mutate(yintercept = g50a, type_lbl = "growth"),
      hline_base %>% mutate(yintercept = g50d, type_lbl = "death"),
      hline_base %>% mutate(yintercept = g50g, type_lbl = "uptake")
    )
  } else if (grepl("model_q", model_name)) {
    # Logic for Q: Plot KG (p[9]) as reference for Glucose affinity
    # Assuming params follow model_q structure
    KG <- exp(as.numeric(pars[1, "logp[9]"]))
    
    hline_base <- tidyr::expand_grid(
      Condition = unique(meta$Condition),
      G0_lbl    = levels(meta$G0_lbl)
    )
    hline_df <- hline_base %>% mutate(yintercept = KG, type_lbl = "KG (uptake)")
  }

  # 4. Plots
  p_counts <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = sims_df %>% filter(type %in% c("NL","ND")), aes(time, value, group = interaction(draw, well_idx, type), color = type)) +
    geom_point(data = obs_df %>% filter(type %in% c("NL","ND")), aes(time, value, shape = factor(exp_id), color = type)) +
    facet_grid(G0_lbl ~ Condition, scales = "free") + theme_bw() + labs(title = "Counts", shape = "Exp")
  
  p_gluc <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = sims_df %>% filter(type == "G"), aes(time, value, group = interaction(draw, well_idx))) +
    geom_point(data = obs_df %>% filter(type == "G"), aes(time, value, shape = factor(exp_id))) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    facet_grid(G0_lbl ~ Condition, scales = "free") + theme_bw() + labs(title = "Glucose", shape = "Exp")

  if (!is.null(hline_df)) {
    p_gluc <- p_gluc + 
      geom_hline(data = hline_df, aes(yintercept = yintercept, color = type_lbl), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8)
  }
  
  # Optional: If Model Q, maybe plot qN internal state?
  # For now keeping it to Counts | Gluc as requested to avoid exploding layout
  
  (p_counts | p_gluc) + plot_annotation(title = paste0(model_name, " - ", cell_line, " ", ploidy, ": PPC"))
}

plot_xi_pars_in_bounds <- function(xi, lp_thresh = 10) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2) })
  stan_data=xi$data
  lp <- xi$lp
  keep <- lp >= (max(lp) - lp_thresh)
  if(sum(keep) == 0) keep <- which.max(lp) # ensure at least 1
  
  pars <- as.data.frame(xi$pars[keep, , drop = FALSE])
  
  log_lower <- log(as.numeric(stan_data$lower_b))
  log_upper <- log(as.numeric(stan_data$upper_b))
  param_names <- paste0("logp[", seq_len(stan_data$N_params), "]")
  bounds <- data.frame(Param = param_names, log_lower = log_lower, log_upper = log_upper)
  
  # Handle cases where pars might have extra columns or mismatch
  available_params <- intersect(colnames(pars), param_names)
  
  df <- pars %>%
    select(all_of(available_params)) %>%
    mutate(.draw = seq_len(n())) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(.draw), names_to = "Param", values_to = "logp") %>%
    left_join(bounds, by = "Param") %>%
    mutate(Param = factor(Param, levels = rev(param_names)))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = logp, y = Param)) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = log_lower, xend = log_upper, yend = Param, color="red")) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(height = 0.35, width = 0)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(xi$cellLine, " ", xi$ploidy, ": logp within ", lp_thresh, " of best"),
      x = "log(parameter)", y = NULL
    )
}

run_y_sim_from_pars <- function(mod, stan_data, pars) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(cmdstanr)
    library(posterior)
  })

  stan_data$calc_sim <- 1L

  log_lower <- log(as.numeric(stan_data$lower_b))
  log_upper <- log(as.numeric(stan_data$upper_b))
  eps <- 1e-6

  out <- vector("list", nrow(pars))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pars))) {
    r <- pars[i, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # Construct logp vector dynamically based on N_params
    p_names <- paste0("logp[", 1:stan_data$N_params, "]")
    logp <- as.numeric(r[, p_names])
    logp <- pmin(pmax(logp, log_lower + eps), log_upper - eps)

    init_list <- list(
      logp      = logp,
      mu_IC_raw = as.numeric(r[, c("mu_IC_raw[1]", "mu_IC_raw[2]")]),
      phi_total = as.numeric(r[, "phi_total"]),
      phi_frac  = as.numeric(r[, "phi_frac"])
    )

    fit <- mod$sample(
      data = stan_data,
      chains = 1,
      iter_warmup = 0,
      iter_sampling = 1,
      fixed_param = TRUE,
      init = list(init_list),
      threads = 1,
      refresh = 0
    )

    out[[i]] <- posterior::as_draws_matrix(fit$draws("y_sim"))
  }

  do.call(rbind, out)
}

run_xi_ppc <- function(xi, mod, model_name, n = 6, cond_label = "Condition") {
  # order pars by best lp
  lp  <- max(xi$lp) - xi$lp
  o   <- order(lp)
  pars <- as.data.frame(xi$pars[o, , drop = FALSE])
  pars <- head(pars, n)

  draws <- run_y_sim_from_pars(
    mod       = mod,
    stan_data = xi$data,
    pars      = pars
  )

  p <- plot_ppc_from_draws(
    draws,
    stan_data = xi$data,
    pars      = pars,
    cell_line = xi$cellLine,
    ploidy    = xi$ploidy,
    model_name = model_name,
    cond_label = cond_label
  )
  
  list(draws = draws, plot = p)
}

# --- Execution ---

if (length(x) > 0) {
  stan_file <- paste0("MCMC/", MODEL_NAME, ".stan")
  mod <- cmdstan_model(stan_file, cpp_options = list(stan_threads = TRUE))
  
  plts <- lapply(x, function(xi) run_xi_ppc(xi, mod = mod, model_name = MODEL_NAME, n=1)$plot)
  bps <- lapply(x, plot_xi_pars_in_bounds)
  
  # To view:
  # plts[[1]]
  # bps[[1]]
}
```
